name: Poncho's Mexican Food
notes: Restaurant's own Clover-backed ordering platform, address confirmed 2990 Jamacha Rd Ste 100, El Cajon (matches work item). The rendered ordering page is JS/virtualized so the Clover REST API (/wp-json/moo-clover/v1/categories and /categories/{uuid}/items) was read directly, per the technique that worked for Filippi's/Los Charros elsewhere in this project. Prices came back in cents and were divided by 100; odd-cent POS-style pricing throughout, no delivery-markup pattern. A handful of modifier-driven items (Tortilla, Rice, Chips, Beans, Guacamole, Pico de Gallo, Agua Fresca, Fountain Drinks, Mini Tacos) returned $0 (priced via required modifiers not read) and were omitted per the no-price rule. Add-on/topping surcharges (the 'Extra' category, e.g. 'X/Cheese') were omitted as modifiers rather than dishes. All 19 real menu categories otherwise captured in full.
